column1: # spec-skills-b: addresses named while writing docs/spec/skills-35-68.md (skills with ids 35-68).
# Only addresses no other file names. Functions first, then data. Evidence for each is in the section of that document that lists it under "Functions read".

column3: (skillId, slot): for a skill whose kind (+0x08) is not 3, takes a free ability record of the 15 at record +0x4440 unless one already carries this id, zeroes it, writes the marker name, the id (+0x20), usable byte (+0x24) = 1 and the skill kind (+0x25), then raises the rank to at least 1; the zeroed cooldown field is why Player_castSkill is not blocked on the cast frame; 10 call sites (9 in the function at 0x1b1534, 1 at 0x1b1d10)

(bolt, Vec3 *from): recursive chain builder of skill 37; picks the nearest live candidate of list +0x50 within the squared range +0x18c that is not yet in list +0x54, links it, then recurses from the new victim and again from the same point until count +0x18b equals max +0x18a; called from ShockProjectile_run 0x2c46f4 and from itself
(bolt, obj) -> 1 when obj is in the chain list +0x54; only caller ShockProjectile_buildChain 0x2c505c

(spell, target or 0): first contact of a rush; damage to the creature run into (stat 0), box damage round the caster (stats 1 and 2), sets spell+0x48; callers Player_onTouch 0x1beb98 and Player_move 0x1b51bc; reads spell+0x48 without a null test
(spell, pos*): moves and pulses the light at spell+0x1c, 72-particle helix, three Spell_rand draws every third frame at level 9 and above; presentation only; only caller SpellCyclone_run 0x2d1f94

(spell, target, int *min, int *max): called by Player_meleeHit 0x1b7000; for a creature target replaces the hit's damage range with skill stat 0 (max up to 20 percent more from Spell_rand), creates a LightEffect, destroys the spell; 204 Spell_rand draws for particles first
(this, reason) once per object (guard +0x60): impact sound when reason != 0, obj_delete, ended flag; callers FireArrowProjectile_run (terrain 1, expiry 0) and FireArrowProjectile_onHit (2)

(this, reason) once per object (guard +0x60): releases the trail, impact effect and one of four sounds (own generator) when reason != 0, obj_delete, ended flag; callers MultiFireProjectile_run and _onHit

(this, reason) once per object (guard +0x60): reason 0 only deletes; otherwise sounds, ring burst, LightEffect, camera shake, then box query of half edge stat 2 and two damage_apply calls per enemy or non-creature object (zero-damage knock-back call, then stat 0 .. 1.2 x stat 0 with flags 0x840); callers ExplodeArrowProjectile_run and _onHit

(spell, creature): eight s16 tint writes at creature +0x90..+0x9e, then fx_modelParticlesNearCamera_1f61c0; called from SpellAncestralCall_run for the owner and for allies in range

(skill, attacker, ownRank) -> fraction added to the critical-hit chance: own rank if the attacker has a SpellCriticalHit, else the first allied player in g_alivePlayers with the spell and within stat 1 x 12 units; statistic 0 x 0.01; only callers damage_apply 0x1e8d5c, 0x1e8d7c, 0x1e8da4

(spell) -> float: called only by Player_takeDamage (0x1b5658) when the player carries a SpellHolyShield and has mana; spawns 241 particles on model sample points (Spell_rand), creates a LightEffect when spell+0x1c <= 0 and then sets spell+0x1c = 0.263, returns slot 10 (stat 0, level) * 0.01 = the fraction of the hit paid from mana; Executed (difftest_combat_round4, 206 of 206)
(slot): when g_pvpModeB is set and g_pvpModeA clear adds 1 to the slot's arena life counter (s16 at 0x50389a + 12 * slot); only caller SpellResurrect_run 0x312e54

(spell, owner): moves owner scale +0xdc by 0.006 per call toward spell +0x1c, counts +0x20 down while equal, sets the end flag +0x24; writes player record +0x4c20 = max(1, scale * 0.75); only caller SpellGiantGrowth_run 0x30945c
(spell, owner): services 47 / 4 / 11 of the 50 particle slots at spell +0x30 (growing / holding / ending); Spell_rand only; only caller SpellGiantGrowth_run 0x30946c
